top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a simple, analytically transparent mechanism (the Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model, with the Dirac velocity vanishing at a magic angle) that was written down seven years before the 2018 experiments found correlated insulating and superconducting states in exactly that tunable system. The citation can be worded around flat bands plus observed phases, leaving the unsettled pairing mechanism out. It opens a new regime with no overlap with recent prizes, and the three-person allocation is the one the committee supporters name consistently, though the Andrei and Cao credit questions remain a weakness. P002 is a mature, well-cross-checked achievement but sits close to the 2005 and 2012 metrology prizes, so I rank it second ahead of no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no collaboration with any credited person on P001 or P002, only shared Gothenburg/Chalmers institutional environment with colleagues
